- **Why p2:** it is the prerequisite for the attachment item of #22871's ruled scope (p2), where the maintainer-approved design record on #8998 names "parse, dedupe, attachments". Today a forward-as-attachment loses the forwarded body. Measured pull is 0 in-tree readers, because there is no mail UI yet. So it is p2, not p1.
